p.INTENT: Give repeated structure explicit typed inputs before considering generation.

p.APPLICABILITY: Repeated model, carrier or glue structure invites automated emission.

p.MOTIVATION: A reader should consume an explicit, checkable operation rather than infer a claim from prose or a stale artifact.

p.STRUCTURE: Model/carrier author and a future deterministic generator.

p.SCOPE: General Lean source/carrier generation is WISH: the initial runner scans/checks, and no generator is commissioned. Generated text would still require ordinary checking.

p.CONSEQUENCES: Makes the declared boundary reviewable; requires explicit inputs, assumptions and checker time. No broader proof grade follows.

p.ALTERNATIVES: A handwritten theorem is clearer while there is no repeated structural need.

p.RISKS: If repetition disappears, retire the generator idea; generated source must never manufacture proof success. Sunset: revise or retire this card when an accepted checker/representation makes its routine obsolete.

p.EVIDENCE: No package-specific empirical result is claimed. [E-hyp].
